name: Bulk vendor actions
whenToUse: Apply a batch action across many vendor ids in one call; use for mass archive/restore/delete instead of acting on one record (mutating).

queryParameters.name: index
queryParameters.description:
Replaces the default response index from data to a user specific string

ie.

```html
  ?index=new_index
```

response is wrapped

```json
  {
    'new_index' : [
      .....
    ]
  }
```
